title: k11 API Contract QA MCP Server
description:
MCP server and Claude Code plugin for API contract testing across OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, gRPC, AsyncAPI and SOAP: finds breaking changes before merge and which consumers they break, down to the fields each one reads or sends, checks deployed services for drift, generates contract tests and posts a verdict on pull requests.

Source code: https://github.com/K11-Software-Solutions/k11techlab-api-contract-qa-mcp
